adjudication_summary: Source re-review repaired the empty activity layer and reconciled linked database rows against the paper XML/PDF text, Table 2 image, supplement text, and database snapshots. The paper is accepted with cautions: several database entries over-assign mutant identity or unsupported variant values, so those rows are preserved as source_conflict instead of being smoothed into source_verified.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary source supports HR2P/HR2P-M1/HR2P-M2 activity values, but these database rows mix mutant identities, unsupported variant values, or a cell-line qualifier not stated for cytotoxicity. They remain source_conflict and are not promoted to source_verified.
Table 2 has no structured XML rows and is represented as an OA package image; exact HR2P, HR2P-M1, and HR2P-M2 sequences and IC50 values were manually read from the listed table image.
Primary source reports no significant cytotoxicity up to 1000 uM and SI >1667; exact CC50 is not available locally and is recorded as a censored/no-effect toxicity row.

materials_exhausted.note: Local material was sufficient to repair activity rows, database reconciliation, and final adjudication. Remaining database disagreements are preserved as source_conflict cautions, not open material gaps.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP activity rows for HR2P/HR2P-M1 and literature links were reconciled to primary-source locators. DRAMP activity rows, CAMP, dbAMP, and HEK293T/ACE2 cytotoxicity qualifier rows that mix identities or unsupported values remain explicit source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered primary-source activity/toxicity rows from Results prose, Figure 6, Supplementary Figure S2, Methods, and graphic-only Table 2; database-only text was not treated as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is accepted at source-supported strength: HR2P blocks viral entry/fusion through HR1/HR2 six-helix-bundle targeting, with optimization and toxicity context kept separate from unsupported antimicrobial/permeabilization claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review: Worker-6 closed the previous full_source_review_not_completed ticket after direct source review and preserved unresolved database disagreements as cautions rather than open rework.
